summary.text: Robert Garza is the Republican nominee for the Texas House of Representatives, District 74, having advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary.
He was the Republican candidate for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Garza ran for Texas House District 74 in 2012, according to Ballotpedia, and lost the May 29 Democratic primary to Poncho Nevarez.
He was the Republican candidate for Texas State Senate District 19 in 2022, when incumbent Roland Gutierrez defeated him in the general election.
In 2024, incumbent Eddie Morales Jr. defeated Garza in the general election for House District 74, 51.7 percent to 48.3 percent.
